title: quiz_details
description: One row per answered question within a submission: the per-answer detail. Source table data/tables/quiz_details.csv. Feeds the `submission_details.json` records; joins to scoring.csv on (quiz_id, submission_id) and to quiz_structure.csv on (quiz_id, question_number).

quiz_id.description: Quiz this answer belongs to. Foreign key to quiz_meta.quiz_id / quiz_structure.quiz_id.

submission_id.description: Submission this answer belongs to. Foreign key to scoring.submission_id.

submitted_at.description: Submission timestamp, ISO-8601 UTC. Matches scoring.submitted_at for the same submission_id.

question_number.description: 1-based position of the question within the quiz. Foreign key to quiz_structure.question_number for this quiz_id.

question.description: The question text as presented. Mirrors quiz_structure.question.

answer.description: The option the respondent selected for this question.

correct.description: Whether the selected answer was correct (answer == quiz_structure.correct_answer).
